*F-pwKE* (Password-authenticated KE) is part of *Public-Key Primitives, Key Exchange, Messaging* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Canetti et al. [*Universally composable password-based key exchange*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2005/196). In Advances in Cryptology – EUROCRYPT 2005, volume 3494 of LNCS, pages 404–421, 2005.
- Goldreich and Lindell. [*Session-key generation using human passwords only*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2000/057). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2001, 2001.
